name: Millet Choco Fills
subtitle: Loaded with Millets | NO MAIDA

description:
One of the first to introduce choco fills with a jaggery-sweetened chocolate center with no refined sugar.

🥣 Millet-rich crunchy cereal shells with a jaggery-sweetened cocoa filling.

❌ No Refined Sugar, No Palm Oil, No Preservatives, No Artificial Colour.

Designed as a ready-to-eat cereal/snack for kids

Ready-to-eat cereal/snack. Serving size: 25 g. Store airtight after opening. 

For 2–3 year olds, please check with your nutritionist before serving.

reviews.author: Kanika.
reviews.title: Tasty & Guilt-Free!
reviews.body: My kids absolutely love these choco fills! I’m happy because they’re made with millets and no refined sugar. Finally, a cereal I can say “yes” to without hesitation!

reviews.author: Aisha
reviews.title: Healthier Snack Option.
reviews.body: Love the idea of a chocolate treat that’s actually healthy! No palm oil, no preservatives, and my toddler keeps asking for more. Highly recommend.
